title: D_Omega higher-N consistency test
verdict: The clean structural derivation D_Omega^V = 1 - (N_gen*d+1)/(d2*(2N_gen-1)) = 67/80 holds AT THE VACUUM ANCHOR (N=50) to 0.3% precision AND with the iter-31 1-loop sub-leading correction gamma2alpha_xi/4 to 0.0255% precision. It does NOT hold as a constant form across all N: at higher N, lattice readouts of D_Omega run (with non-monotonic dips at binary-power regimes) toward the matter-side asymptote pi/d. Both vacuum 67/80 = 1 - 13/80 and matter pi/d are structurally derivable from (d, N_gen) alone -- but they describe two distinct regime identifications rather than a single algebraic form. The C2 identity D_Omega = beta_pi - gamma was an algebraic coincidence at vacuum that fails under chirality running.
